newsitem.title: INDIA: India ABB firm in 600 million rupee order.
newsitem.headline: India ABB firm in 600 million rupee order.

text.p: India's ABB Asea Babcock Ltd (ABL), part of the Asea Brown Boveri group said on Tuesday it had received boiler orders worth 600 million rupees from two local firms.

ABB ABL, involved in power and industrial boilers, received one order from DLF Industries Ltd on behalf of Mangalore Refineries & Petrochemicals Ltd and an order from Neyveli Lignite Corporaion (NLC).
The DLF order is for the design, manufacturing, supply and installation of four 140 tonnes per hour oil-fired boilers for MRPL's power project, it said in a statement.
The company said the second order was for NLC's boiler unit of its power project.
